description:
Job Summary 
 Systems Engineer L2 IT Telecomms System Engineer Mumbai Permanent / Full Time Join the largest Australian-owned systems integrator Work in a supportive and fast paced environment Opportunity to engage with global clients to deliver great outcomes 
 
 Role 
 As a vital part of the Managed Services and Operations team, you ll take the lead in standardising, configuring, and automating provisioning, remediation, updates, and roadmaps for desktop environments-particularly using Microsoft Intune, SCCM, AutoPilot, and related tools. While your focus will be on enterprise-level clients, your contributions will directly impact the broader Brennan IT managed services ecosystem. You ll be the go-to expert for resolving complex, high-impact technical challenges, and you ll help define and enforce best practices that ensure a consistent, secure, and scalable desktop experience for our clients. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain standards and best practices for OSD/SOE, Intune, and application deployment across large enterprise environments. Design, audit, and optimise end-to-end deployment solutions, from AutoPilot based provisioning to SCCM-driven SOE rollouts. Ensure patch compliance and system updates across client environments using Intune update rings or SCCM. Lead pilot rollouts, driver updates, application packaging, and image management. Act as an escalation point for complex issues from the Managed Services and Operations teams. Support application lifecycle management via Windows Store and SCCM. Work closely with cross-functional teams including Network, Product Engineering, and Automation to create and maintain service catalogue items and automation scripts. Contribute to knowledge sharing and training within the wider team. Help clients transition toward a modern hybrid infrastructure, recommending the best approach (Intune/AutoPilot vs SCCM/SOE) on a per-device basis. 
 
 Key Competencies 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 5+ years of experience in Endpoint Management within enterprise environments. Expert-level knowledge of Wintel environments and a broad range of infrastructure technologies. Proven experience with SCCM, including SOE builds, device updates, and application deployment. Advanced proficiency with Microsoft AutoPilot and Intune MDM for modern device management. Strong understanding of automation capabilities within SCCM and Intune, including API integrations and scripting (e.g., PowerShell). In-depth knowledge of patch management using Intune, SCCM, or similar endpoint management tools. Familiarity with Tanium or similar endpoint security platforms. Experience acting as the final escalation point for complex, high-impact technical issues. Strong skills in root cause analysis and problem resolution. Solid ITSM queue management abilities and a disciplined approach to ticket handling. Experience conducting technical workshops and knowledge sharing sessions with both clients and internal teams. Willingness and ability to travel to client sites for hands-on support when required. A proactive, do-what-it-takes attitude with a customer-first mindset. Relevant industry certifications (such as Microsoft, ITIL, or equivalent) are highly desirable. 
 
 Desirable Skills Experience 
 Subject matter expertise (SME) in Intune, with deep technical knowledge and hands-on experience. Previous experience working in an outsourced service delivery environment or Managed Service Provider (MSP) setting. Solid understanding of ITIL principles and service management methodologies. Practical experience with cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure and/or AWS. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including Azure networking components, and familiarity with SQL administration, SQL Reporting Services, PowerBI and Graph API. Microsoft 365 certifications or equivalent industry-recognised credentials. 
 
 Key Performance Indicators 
 Delivering high performance is a key part of our culture. You will be provided with your specific KPIs / targets / goals once you commence to provide clarity on where to focus your efforts. Note: These KPIs/targets/goals are indicative only and will be confirmed with your Leader when you commence the role. Your official and measurable KPIs/targets/goals will be recorded in your Performance Plans. Any future changes to your KPIs/targets/goals will be updated in IntelliHR.

title: Senior Consultant ALM
description:
The Senior Consultant ALM will lead the design, configuration, and governance of SAP Cloud ALM for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations. The role focuses on establishing end-to-end ALM practices across requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. The consultant will define ALM governance frameworks including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and KPIs, while ensuring performance tuning and Basis-level support. Acting as the ALM workstream lead, the role involves stakeholder engagement, solution architecture advisory, and transition into operations. Must Have 8+ years experience working in Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) roles across at least 3 enterprise SAP implementations. Handson experience designing, configuring, and operating modern ALM toolsets in SAP landscapes, with recent practical experience using SAP Cloud ALM in a Public Cloud implementation. Proven ability to apply ALM practices across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, build, testing, release, deployment, and operations. Experience leading the ALM workstream on SAP programmes, with a proven ability to define and enforce ALM governance including standards, templates, traceability, quality gates, and reporting Proficiency in performance monitoring, tuning, and Basis-level tasks. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting other. Nice to Have Handson experience with Codebeamer, Windchill RV&S, or similar enterprise ALM platforms. Experience managing coexistence or transition between Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM. Experience integrating ALM with CI/CD or DevOps pipelines. Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Day-To-Day: SAP Cloud ALM workstream leadership and planning Configure and run SAP Cloud ALM for requirements, testing, defects, releases, and operations readiness. Support consulting and implementation projects for Application Lifecycle Management (ALM). Support the definition of client specific solution architectures for ALM & PLM; with focus on Application Architecture or Technical Architecture as required. Analyse requirements, design solutions, and successfully implement solutions with the help of cross-functional teams. Ensure quality through appropriate methods and software engineering processes. Roles & Responsibilities Develop organisational strategies, runbooks and roadmaps for SAP Cloud ALM. Establish SAP Cloud ALM governance: templates, standards, naming conventions, traceability rules, release gates, and quality KPIs. Configure SAP Cloud ALM scenarios based on client requirements and following SAP best practices. Drive and deliver system upgrades, performance tuning, and test automation. Provide technical support for ALM-related issues to implementation teams and clients. Engage with internal and client stakeholders around Cloud ALM processes, including workshops and advisory/SME sessions. Stay current with the latest SAP ALM tools and best practices and delivery though-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.
